为保护大家免受骚扰，我和那两个爱惹事生非的拳头，在擂台上展开了一番较量！
总结来说，那对拳头最大的特征就是，嗯……闻起来……唔……有了！是像蛋白粉那样的味道！不过说不定是因为热血过头，似乎有点儿烧焦了……
力气比我想象的要来得强劲！而且不光如此！我打算多绕点圈子寻找破绽的时候，突然感觉从脚底下的擂台传来了一阵强烈的热度……紧接着，刚刚有点疲倦、就快松懈下来的拳头，居然又变得干劲满满了！
这难道是擂台战的回合规则吗！？真是一分一秒都大意不得呀！我长见识了！下次一定要抓紧时间赢下来——
Content.LocalizedString:
Had to square off with those two rowdy fists to protect everyone!
The most distinct thing about them was this… protein powder smell… But after the scuffle, they smelled kinda burnt, perhaps from overexcitement.
They were stronger than I thought! And just when I was circling for a weak spot, the ring heated up, and those fading fists got a second wind.
Must be some ring battle rule. Can't let my guard down—not even for a sec! Well, I learned my lesson. Next time I'll wrap it up quickly!

哼，我猜它分辨不出普通人和异能者的战斗力差距，怕不是单看谁个子长得大就向谁约战吧？竟然一上来，把我当成那种手无缚鸡之力的小孩子，拒绝跟我打呢！结果，还得先被我骂几句才行。
把它揍趴之后……不知道是不是因为这家伙待在露天地方风吹雨打久了，还有股脏兮兮的汗臭，连鬼郎丸都不是很想吃……要不带回去丢给娜娜莉随便玩玩算了？
Content.LocalizedString:

Seems like they can't tell an Esper from the average Joe. Perhaps they pick fights based on size? They even mistook me for a pushover and refused to fight! So I had to scold some sense into them first.
After I knocked them out, they looked super weathered and reeked of sweat—yuck! Even Kiroumaru turned up its nose… Might just let Nanally have them as toys.

理论上来说，只要你不想把它关上，「增殖的C」是不会对人造成伤害的。它既不会主动对人发起攻击，也不会因为外界的影响而倒塌，哪怕是直接撞在纸箱形成的墙上都不会。但我还是想在这里告诫所有的异象猎人：不要因为「增殖的C」不会主动伤害人就放下警惕心！因为「增殖的C」会根据人的行为增殖出新的箱子——这就意味着，你的下一步可能畅通无阻，也可能会直接撞在墙上。因此，放慢脚步，看清前路。
顺便，尽管「增殖的C」外表是纸箱，但是实际上非常的坚硬，如果撞上去的话......可能需要了解一下换一个合金鼻梁骨的价格....
Content.LocalizedString:
In theory, as long as you don't try to close it, Proliferative C won't harm people. It doesn't actively attack humans, nor will it collapse due to external influences, even if you crash directly into the walls formed by the cardboard boxes. Though, I still want to warn all Anomaly Hunters here: don't let your guard down just because Proliferative C won't actively harm people! Proliferative C spawns new boxes based on human behavior, which means your next step might be completely clear, or you might crash straight into a wall. Therefore, slow down and watch where you're going.
By the way, although Proliferative C looks like cardboard boxes, they're actually extremely hard. If you crash into them… you might want to look into the price of getting a new alloy nose bridge…

Content.SourceString: 对于异象「增殖的C」来说，值得讨论的点还很多。最初认为箱子在被「增殖的C」附着后会在原地开始增殖，并生成迷宫，但实际上「增殖的C」出现的场所和迷宫的形状都是随机的，而最近本人的经历也会改变先前对「增殖的C」的认知——普遍认为「增殖的C」增殖出的箱子外观上跟本体完全相同，但在本人最近的一次泯除「增殖的C」的过程中遇到了完全不同的箱子。至于这些箱子是否有其他特殊的作用，还需要对「增殖的C」进行更多的接触才能确认。
Content.LocalizedString: Proliferative C warrants additional discussion. Contrary to initial beliefs that the boxes would multiply when in contact and form a maze, it has been observed that the emergence points and maze configurations are unpredictable. My recent encounters have revealed variations in the boxes produced by Proliferative C, deviating from the original entity. The potential for unique functionalities within these new boxes requires further investigation.

「这位老先生，您在报告单上填写的是：偶遇红色的门的异象，并发现了奇特之处。关于这一点，方便说得更详细些吗？」
「哦吼吼！莫急、莫急。待老夫慢慢道来，那是正正好的正午，老夫为下午的买卖掐指一算，卦象为……呃，天机，泄露不得。总之，收了我的摊子往半角街走着……」
「该异象被目击于白天，半角街附近。」
「正午！正午！年轻人做事毛毛糙糙，得亏有老夫指点。」
「当事人强调遭遇时间为正午，是否为关键因素仍需确定。」
「这路啊，走着走着，可就走不动了。嚯！堵得严严实实，楞是找不到半条缝钻！」
「年轻人有所不知，揣度天机之人呐，最看中的就是脚下所走的这条『路』，遭遇异象，就是注定之『路』。既然天与我此意，怎有不遵从的道理！前面就是刀山火海也得给它闯了！」
「老夫虽比不上你们异象猎人的实力，但自保的能力还是有几分。那门内空间，看似真实，实则彼方世界的投影。稍有不慎则迷失其中，沦为里面怪东西的盘中餐。而老夫能身游虚境脱身而出，靠的就是老夫这珍藏多年，有着明目启智之效的……」
「抱歉打断一下，JTF，指的是联合特遣队。」
「我都半截身子进土的老东西了，认不清你们的这个缩写那个代号不是很正常？刚刚说到了哪儿？」
「您所见到的异象空间并非真实存在。这是个十分新颖的观点。关于它可以展开说说吗？」
「啧……我且问你。这个异象表里分别有红蓝两种门。有何深意呐？嵌在墙上的红色的那个连接着真实世界你们都知道了，但串联其虚拟空间的是蓝色的门……这，就是关键所在！我有一物，可鉴真伪。离这红色的门越近呐，它就颤动得越厉害，就像你的脉搏一样勃勃有力。离蓝色的门越近，就越是静如死水。这能说明什么？里面那个世界，从头到尾都是假的！什么失踪教学楼，重现的校园时光，多半是不想上班的小鬼逃避现实瞎掰扯出来的美梦，恰遂了那个吃人世界的意！要我是它啊，也得披上这么一层假模假样的外衣忽悠人进来……多亏了我这串宝贝手串，我才能在其中化险为夷，没被里面的歧骸生吞喽！今日你我相逢一场，也是命中注定。我观你与它命运遥遥相应，有意忍痛割爱，完善这桩机缘，以你方斯交换此物……（广告内容，已处理）」
「……谢谢您所提供的信息。」
（「赤门」内异象空间疑似教学楼的情景疑为呼应人之所想而显现的「假象」，并非真实存在过的教学楼……虽然这位市民朋友说了很多，但从中能提炼到的有用信息份量并不算重。我怀疑这都是他为推销那串神奇手链胡编的故事……但如果不是呢？比如那串手链真是一个能看破虚伪的异象？呃，我是不是真该买下来？）
Content.LocalizedString:
"Sir, in your report you mentioned encountering an anomaly with a red door and noticing something unusual. Could you elaborate on that?"
"Oh ho ho! Patience, young one. Let me tell you… It was high noon precisely. I was calculating my afternoon sales when—ah, but I mustn't reveal heaven's secrets. Anyway, I packed up my stall and headed to Hankaku Street…"
"The anomaly was sighted during the day, near Hankaku Street."
"Noon! It was noon! You youngsters are so careless. Lucky you have me to set you straight."
"The witness emphasizes the time as noon. Whether this is a crucial factor remains to be determined."
"As I walked, I suddenly couldn't move forward. The path was completely blocked, not even a crack to squeeze through!"
"You see, young one, those who interpret heaven's will, value the path we walk above all. Encountering an anomaly is a destined path. If heaven wills it, how can I not obey? Even if it led to certain doom, I had to press on!"
"While I may not match you Anomaly Hunters in strength, I can certainly fend for myself. That space beyond the door, it seemed real, but it was merely a projection of another world. One misstep and you'd be lost, becoming a meal for the creatures inside. But I, with my years of experience and my prized possession that sharpens the mind and clears the vision…"
"Excuse me, JTF stands for Joint Task Force."
"I'm basically a half-dead man! It's only natural I don't know all your acronyms and codes. Now, where was I?"
"You mentioned that the Anomalous Realm you saw wasn't truly real. That's quite an interesting observation. Could you expand on that?"
"Tch… Let me ask you this. This anomaly has both red and blue doors, inside and out. What's the meaning behind that? You all know the red door in the wall connects to the real world, but the blue doors link the virtual spaces… That's the key! I have an item that can discern truth from falsehood. The closer to the red door, the more it vibrates, like a strong pulse. But near the blue doors, it's still as death. What does this tell us? That world inside is entirely fake! The disappearing school building, reliving campus days—it's all a beautiful dream conjured by some work-shy youngster, playing right into that man-eating world's hands! If I were it, I'd put on such a false front to lure people in too… Thanks to my precious prayer beads, I escaped unscathed, not devoured by the Oddities inside! Our meeting today was fated. I see your destiny is intertwined with it. I'm willing to part with this treasure, to perfect this destined encounter. In exchange for some Fons… (Advertisement content removed)"
"…Thank you for your information."
(The anomaly space inside the Red Door resembling a school building scenario is suspected to be a "mirage" manifesting in response to people's thoughts, not a real school building that ever existed… Although this citizen friend said a lot, the amount of useful information extracted is not substantial. I suspect this is a story he made up to sell that magical bracelet… But what if it's not? For instance, if that bracelet really is an anomaly that can see through falsehoods? Uh, should I really buy it?)

不过嘛，这个异象还挺对我胃口，没有那么多弯弯绕绕的东西，打起来……额……完全不是我的对手！我有想过把它收入家族，以后骑着机车和镰刀出场，一看就是主角的样子，只是它没法沟通……唉……「暴走族的审判者」想想也挺酷？就这么泯除了好像还怪可惜的……

The so-called king of racers… Headless Rider… Didn't bother to inquire before coming here. This street, this road, this Hethereau, is under the protection of my the Coluccis. Daring to bully my underlings on my turf?
Well, my underlings took me, the Ichi-daime boss, on a patrol, and it immediately took the bait. The scythe and motorcycle entrance were pretty cool, with the blue flames looking intense, but it was just superficially intimidating. I've seen far more terrifying Espers in my time!
However, this anomaly suited my taste; it didn't have too many twists and turns. In a fight… uh… it was no match for me at all! I considered recruiting it into the family, riding a motorcycle with a scythe, looking like the main character. But it couldn't communicate… sigh… "Judge of the Night Racers" sounds pretty cool, doesn't it? It's almost a shame it got nullified like that…

Content.SourceString:
算不上麻烦的异象，通常情况下冲进去收拾一顿就行。但即使如此，每次接到这种委托，我们组所有人都会变得格外谦让有礼，彼此推辞，最终只能由抽签决定哪个倒霉蛋撞此大运。
你应该知道「灵感终结者」制造的异象空间，是根据它吸取到的灵感夸张变化来的吧？也就是说，那玩意可以说是一个超巨型点子具象化主题乐园。往那儿一站，你就知道被偷点子的那人究竟在想什么。
这可完全称不上有趣，这么跟你说吧：那时我接到了我最崇拜的漫画家下的委托，如果不帮她解决这个大麻烦，连载的结尾可就……总之带着可以帮到偶像的虔诚惶恐的心情，我踏进了异象空间，结果发现那就是由她酝酿的最后一话的「灵感」生成的。猝不及防，我被提前剧透了个干干净净……追连载时的期待，和别人讨论伏笔时的激动，属于这部作品所有的满足感……就这样草率又仓促的碎掉了。本该……我本该和其他朋友们一起庆祝它迎来最后一话，既幸福又不舍地慢慢读完这个故事……
咳咳，扯远了。不管怎么说，这个根据人们灵感生成的异象空间，甚至比其他异象弄出来的还要复杂。如果灵感主人是恐怖片导演，恭喜你将收获一段永生难忘的惊魂体验。我有位同事，差点迷失在推理小说家的灵感空间里，属实把人吓得不轻。这能算工伤吗？
对了，还有最重要的一点。通常我们会被要求签一些保密协议、合同啊什么的。毕竟我们是除了委托人以外唯一知道这个想法的人。虽说可以理解，但条条框框的就是很烦人啊？委托费算不上高，规矩倒一个不少！谁乐意接这种活嘛……
Content.LocalizedString:
These Anomalies aren't usually troublesome—just a quick cleanup. But when we get these commissions, everyone tries to pass them off until we draw lots.
You probably know that the Anomalous Realms they create are like warped theme parks of the stolen inspiration. One step in there and you'll know exactly what was going on in the victim's head.
It's not as fun as it sounds. I once helped my favorite manga artist and got the ultimate spoiler for her series' ending. All the anticipation and excitement, gone in an instant. I was looking forward to celebrating the final chapter with my friends and savoring the story's end…
Sorry, got carried away there. These realms can be more complex than others. If the inspiration's owner is a horror director, you're in for an unforgettable nightmare. A colleague nearly got lost in a mystery novelist's realm and was freaking out. Would that count as a workplace injury?
We also have to sign NDAs and contracts, which is a pain. The commission fee isn't high, but the regulations are endless. No wonder nobody wants these jobs…

Content.SourceString:
「不可自拔」影片时长的异常，我们已经有了点眉目。
就拿最近很火爆的「放学后」来打比方。你可能听说过，那是一个讲述主人公被「玩伴」困在放学后的校舍，经过反复尝试最终成功回家的故事。
一边遵循着「玩伴」们一二三木头人的游戏规则，一边绕过重重阻碍找到离开学校的方法。若忘记时不时回头看看「玩伴」，则会被他们逮回去导致前功尽弃。难怪主人公会一次又一次重返起点，循环往复，直到这部漫长的影片结束……对吧？
然而经过我们研究确认，这部电影正常的片长只有几分钟。社交网络上所流传的异常片长版本，是有人刻意将主人公在校园中反复试错循环往复的部分剪辑拷贝，导致观感上「从头再来」这件事仿佛无穷无尽。
到底是什么人有能力编辑异象影片？这会是他的异能吗？他究竟为什么要这样做？这些疑问都还有待进一步调查。
Content.LocalizedString:
We've got some clues about the unusual length of Doomscroll videos.
Take the recently popular "After School" as an example. You might have heard of it; it's about a protagonist trapped in the school building after school with "friends", who eventually finds a way home after many attempts.
Following the rules of the "Red Light, Green Light" game while overcoming obstacles to find a way out of the school. Your "friends" will catch you if you're not careful, and all your efforts will be in vain. No wonder the protagonist keeps returning to the start, repeating the cycle until the lengthy video ends, right?
However, our research confirms that the normal length of this movie is just a few minutes. The extended versions circulating on social media were deliberately edited to repeat the trial and error cycles, creating the impression of endlessness.
Who has the power to edit Anomaly Videos? Could this be their Asper Ability? Why do they do this? These questions require further investigation.

有句话怎么说来着？每条看起来很离谱的规矩背后都是更加离谱的现实教训……
究竟是谁——故意——在地上涂画了那么逼真的「水渍」——还有模有样地在上面撑起一把黑伞啊！！！
当时……满怀「抓住你了」的激动心情，我特意整理了下袖口，打算以最灵活最有把握的姿态扑向面前的「雨人」，速战速决来着！
结果却是一个猛扑摔在了地上，灰头土脸险些咬到了舌头，头上还顶着那把和雨人如此酷似，但又如假包换的雨伞！！！制服上蹭得全是模拟水渍画出来的，黏糊糊又黑咕隆咚的涂鸦喷漆！！！
到底是谁干的啊！！！
Content.LocalizedString:
I really wish they'd make a new regulation: No graffiti artists allowed to draw potentially misleading art on Hethereau's streets!
You know what they say? Behind every ridiculous rule is an even more ridiculous lesson learned…
Just who—deliberately—drew such a realistic water puddle on the ground—and even topped it off with a black umbrella?!
At that moment… Filled with excitement thinking "Gotcha!", I rolled up my sleeves and got ready to pounce on the Rainman in front of me with my most agile and confident stance, planning to end this quickly!
Instead, I face-planted right into the ground, nearly bit my tongue, and ended up with this umbrella on my head that looked just like a Rainman's but was absolutely, positively fake! And now my uniform is covered in this sticky, pitch-black spray paint that was used to draw those fake water stains!!!
Who in the world did this?!

唉，那一刻心都碎成渣渣了……

嗯嗯……看官们不要走开，因为事情还没完！
回到家以后，我照镜子，发现脸上的「波普彩妆」还挺好看？诶？诶不是！这也算一种「签名」吧？算吧？？？呜哇，开心！要速速分享给大家！

关于那个实拍视频被转了很多的鲤鱼旗从天上飞下来的异象……哦或者说河流异象吧。
说实话一点也理解不了说喜欢那异象的人在惊叹些什么，还有人说想特地去现场看。拜托，如果只是觉得那场景很漂亮的话用CG动画技术不是也完全可以做到吗？难道这在电影里还少见吗？
「带来生机」、「感谢恩赐」那类的蠢话看得我差点以为我不是点进评论区而是走进了什么白痴大本营。本来有谁指望过在那些钢筋水泥的楼房最顶上搞什么绿化？确定不是在给人添麻烦？

而说到那个被津津乐道的「龙门」试炼，更让我觉得被耍了还不自知的人不是一般的多。
首先这些鱼是半透明的，你们仔细看都能看出来，对吧？他们没有实体，对吧？你其实根本阻挡不了他们，因为它们完全有能力从你的身体中直接穿过去，而且绝大多数的攻击手段也是完全不可能伤到他们的，对吧？
它们想跳就能跳过去，想打也可以继续打下去，但非要故意做出能被人类阻挡、能被击中的样子，只为了呈现出就像是真的在接受某种试炼……
嚯？所以咱们就动用一大堆人力费尽心思装腔作势地配合，还要小心别挡得太敷衍让它们成功了——明明只要它们想成功谁也挡不住？门口两个小孩过家家吵起来打闹都算是你来我往胜负难分的较量呢，这算是什么？
不说明白点就没法理解吗？好多人被异象耍着玩回头还要夸一句可爱，给我乐着了，异象眼里你才傻得可爱。

到头来不还是同样的那套恶性异象的做派吗？强迫人类配合自己的规则、不遵照着去做就给你点颜色看看。
啊我懂了——原来只要把形式做得好看点，再给点甜头尝尝，大家就都会觉得这是个「好」异象啊。
连这异象害死过多少人也是可以抛到脑后的。当然了，你可以回我一句「真相不明的事情别拿出来传播」，挺好的，今后也这样，事事都只看好的一面，从好的角度去解读，这可真是太「好」了。
保持这份纯真直到被坑死为止吧。
Content.LocalizedString:
Regarding that video of the Anomaly with many carp streamers flying down from the sky… or should I say River Anomaly.
Honestly, I don't understand what those who like that Anomaly are amazed by, and some even want to go see it in person. Please, if it's just because you think the scene is beautiful, can't CG animation technology achieve the same thing? Isn't this common in movies?
Statements like "life is beautiful" or "thankful for the gift" almost made me think I walked into a fool's sanctuary instead of a comment section. Did anyone expect to do some greening on top of those reinforced concrete buildings? Isn't that just creating trouble?

And speaking of the much-talked-about "Trial of the Dragon Gate", it made me feel that there are an unusually large number of people who are being played without realizing it.
First of all, these fish are semi-transparent, you can see it if you look closely, right? They have no physical form, right? You actually can't block them because they can completely pass through your body, and most attacks can't possibly harm them, right?
They can jump over if they want, and continue the fight if they wish, but they deliberately act as if they can be blocked by humans, as if they're truly undergoing some kind of trial…
Oh? So we use a bunch of manpower to put on a show and play around with them, being careful not to block them too perfunctorily lest they succeed—when clearly, if they wanted to succeed, no one could stop them? Two kids squabbling in the neighborhood entrance is more of a back-and-forth struggle than this, right? What is this?
Is it impossible to understand without explaining it clearly? So many people play along with the Anomaly and then praise it as cute, which amuses me because, in the Anomaly's eyes, you're the one who's adorably foolish.

In the end, isn't it just the same old Malicious Anomaly behavior? Forcing humans to comply with its rules, punishing those who don't.
Ah, I get it—so as long as the form looks good and there's a bit of sweetness, everyone will think it's a "good" anomaly.
Even the fact that this anomaly has harmed many can be conveniently forgotten. Now, hit me with the "Ohhhh don't be such a grumpy conspiracy theorist!" Which is fine! From now on, everything will be viewed from a positive angle, interpreted in a good light! Such positivity! Much love! Wowzers!
Ignorance really is bliss, huh.

……你没听错，那套设备的确是我的。我在克莱门学园初次接触电子音乐创作时，以及刚开始商业创作的阶段，它们始终伴我左右。我以为它们被我的经纪人丢掉了，没想到变成了异象，还回到了这个地方……真是惭愧。
其实，我是个异能者，你可以理解为，在作曲的时候，我能够听到一些……乐器和设备的「心声」。
我从小就痴迷游戏机里的音乐，在自己开始创作后也会融入这些元素，包括我的艺名也与它有关。在我早年的作品里，那些特殊的音色就像是我的私心和标签一样，而「它们」也很喜欢。我们就这样一边摸索着音乐创作，一边探讨、打磨我们引以为豪的作品，才走到了今天这一步……但也停在了这一步。
我被签到音乐公司后，经常要在大音乐节和商务晚会进行演出，或者承接影视作品的OST，甲方们都不喜欢这种听上去就古早廉价的音色，还有我过于街头的气质。最开始，我是反叛的，我不顾公司反对，坚持着自己的风格，我相信优秀的作品终会得到认可。后来，在一次大型晚会的现场，我拿出了我们呕心沥血的新作，在音乐的高潮举起了双手……
但是台下毫无反应。没有人理会我们精心炮制的节奏和旋律，没有人起立欢呼，没有人摇摆身体，甚至……没有人从眼中展露出哪怕一丝一毫的兴奋。那些观众只是礼节性地鼓掌几下，随后交头接耳，不时发出优越的嗤笑……那一天，我没能完成表演，草草下场，把那套设备封存在了别墅的地下室……连同我过去的所有东西一起。

抱歉，让你听这么多自我美化的言辞。说到底，我是为了更好的发展主动背弃了自己，也背弃了它们。这没什么好辩驳的。我很欣慰，它们选择了回到那里，回到曾和我一起创作心爱作品的地方。我已经回不去了。
……另外，我找到你们，还有一个请求。
如果已经到了不得不处置它的地步，请求你们在收容……或者泯除它之前，把它的音乐完整地录制、保留下来。
它的声音不该被泯灭。
Content.LocalizedString:
…You heard right, that equipment really is mine. When I first got into electronic music at Clement Academy, and during my early commercial work, it was always by my side. I thought my agent had thrown it away, but it turned out it became an Anomaly and came back here… I'm truly ashamed.
Actually, I'm an Esper. You could say that when I compose, I can hear the "voices" of instruments and equipment.
I've been obsessed with video game music since I was little, and when I started creating my own music, I'd always incorporate those elements. Even my stage name ties back to it! In my early works, those unique sounds were like my personal touch and signature, and "they" loved it too. We explored music creation together, discussing and perfecting the works we were proud of, which brought us to where we are today… but also where we stopped…
After I was signed to a music company, I often had to perform at big music festivals and corporate events, or work on soundtracks for films and TV shows. The clients all disliked those sounds that seemed outdated and cheap, and pushed back against my street vibes. At first, I was rebellious. I ignored the company's objections and stuck to my style, believing that great work would eventually be recognized. Then, at a major event, I presented our painstakingly crafted new piece and raised my hands during the climax…
But there was no reaction from the audience. No one cared about our carefully crafted rhythms and melodies, no one stood up to cheer, no one swayed their bodies, and… no one showed even the slightest bit of excitement in their eyes. The audience just gave polite applause, then whispered among themselves, occasionally letting out condescending snickers… That day, I couldn't finish the performance. I left the stage hastily and sealed that equipment away in my mansion's basement… along with everything from my past.

Sorry for making you listen to all this self-serving talk. In the end, I actively betrayed who I was, and I betrayed them… all for better opportunities. There's no arguing with that. I'm glad they chose to return there, back to the place where we used to create our beloved works together. I can never go back.
…Also, I came to you with one more request.
If it comes to the point where you have to deal with it, please record and preserve its music completely before you contain… or nullify it.
Its voice shouldn't be silenced.

Yeah, yeah, I ran into it while delivering packages. Wow, that Anomaly Hunter was so pitiful, getting chased around everywhere by a big bear doll, so I stepped in to lend a hand. Its armor was actually super sturdy! Luckily, Lady Haniel with her incredible eyesight spotted its weakness right away. I saw a black shadow streak across two pages, and in the next panel, the pink-haired protagonist gracefully landed while the unbreakable bear warrior behind her was split in two and collapsed to the ground. The final frame should show Lady Haniel's freeze-frame close-up, yes, yes.
Ah, I'm getting off track, off track! As for the little bear doll left behind after nullification, I asked the old lady at the tailor shop to fix it up. When we defeated the doll, a little wooden horse fell out from the cotton stuffing. That badly beaten Anomaly Hunter said it was his favorite toy as a child, and he couldn't even remember when he lost it. Afterward, both the wooden horse toy and the little bear doll were sent to the Bureau of Anomaly Control for testing. The results showed they weren't Anomalies at all, just ordinary toys. I already returned the little wooden horse to that Anomaly Hunter. I wanted to give him the little bear doll too, but before I could, he ran off faster than when he was getting beaten up.
Hmm… I still can't help but wonder about it. Abandoned toys, a beaten-up Anomaly Hunter… Could it be!? Was that big bear doll a guardian spirit of toys, punishing people who don't cherish their toys? If that's the case, then were we actually the villains in this fairy tale?!

When my senior assigned me the Eternal Lamp containment quest, they told me it was just a really simple task, so I didn't think much of it. By the time I got to the quest location it was already pretty late, and I figured I'd grab some late-night snacks from the convenience store first… But when I came to my senses, the whole area was covered in thick fog! Plus the streetlights were flickering on and off, and some weren't working at all.
In theory… in theory none of that should be scary… but I had just watched this horror movie that was also set on dark streets, and remembering those scenes suddenly made me super, super scared! Oh, but I'm not scared anymore! Movies are just movies!
As for the actual containment quest… a few lights appeared in the black fog, and some humanoid figures approached… I knew those were Eternal Lamps, but I really made a mistake! I was so terrified that I forgot I was supposed to contain them, and I got a bit too heavy-handed and ended up nullifying them all…
Ah, after I nullified them, the power in the area was restored immediately.
Oh right, and the steamed buns at that nearby convenience store taste really good!

「带来生机」、「感谢恩赐」那类的蠢话看得我差点以为我不是点进评论区而是走进了什么白痴大本营。本来有谁指望过在那些钢筋水泥的楼房最顶上搞什么绿化？确定不是在给人添麻烦？

而说到那个被津津乐道的「龙门」试炼，更让我觉得被耍了还不自知的人不是一般的多。
首先这些鱼是半透明的，你们仔细看都能看出来，对吧？他们没有实体，对吧？你其实根本阻挡不了他们，因为它们完全有能力从你的身体中直接穿过去，而且绝大多数的攻击手段也是完全不可能伤到他们的，对吧？
它们想跳就能跳过去，想打也可以继续打下去，但非要故意做出能被人类阻挡、能被击中的样子，只为了呈现出就像是真的在接受某种试炼……
嚯？所以咱们就动用一大堆人力费尽心思装腔作势地配合，还要小心别挡得太敷衍让它们成功了——明明只要它们想成功谁也挡不住？门口两个小孩过家家吵起来打闹都算是你来我往胜负难分的较量呢，这算是什么？
不说明白点就没法理解吗？好多人被异象耍着玩回头还要夸一句可爱，给我乐着了，异象眼里你才傻得可爱。

到头来不还是同样的那套恶性异象的做派吗？强迫人类配合自己的规则、不遵照着去做就给你点颜色看看。
啊我懂了——原来只要把形式做得好看点，再给点甜头尝尝，大家就都会觉得这是个「好」异象啊。
连这异象害死过多少人也是可以抛到脑后的。当然了，你可以回我一句「真相不明的事情别拿出来传播」，挺好的，今后也这样，事事都只看好的一面，从好的角度去解读，这可真是太「好」了。
保持这份纯真直到被坑死为止吧。

Regarding that video of the Anomaly with many carp streamers flying down from the sky… or should I say River Anomaly.
Honestly, I don't understand what those who like that Anomaly are amazed by, and some even want to go see it in person. Please, if it's just because you think the scene is beautiful, can't CG animation technology achieve the same thing? Isn't this common in movies?
Statements like "life is beautiful" or "thankful for the gift" almost made me think I walked into a fool's sanctuary instead of a comment section. Did anyone expect to do some greening on top of those reinforced concrete buildings? Isn't that just creating trouble?

And speaking of the much-talked-about "Trial of the Dragon Gate", it made me feel that there are an unusually large number of people who are being played without realizing it.
First of all, these fish are semi-transparent, you can see it if you look closely, right? They have no physical form, right? You actually can't block them because they can completely pass through your body, and most attacks can't possibly harm them, right?
They can jump over if they want, and continue the fight if they wish, but they deliberately act as if they can be blocked by humans, as if they're truly undergoing some kind of trial…
Oh? So we use a bunch of manpower to put on a show and play around with them, being careful not to block them too perfunctorily lest they succeed—when clearly, if they wanted to succeed, no one could stop them? Two kids squabbling in the neighborhood entrance is more of a back-and-forth struggle than this, right? What is this?
Is it impossible to understand without explaining it clearly? So many people play along with the Anomaly and then praise it as cute, which amuses me because, in the Anomaly's eyes, you're the one who's adorably foolish.

In the end, isn't it just the same old Malicious Anomaly behavior? Forcing humans to comply with its rules, punishing those who don't.
Ah, I get it—so as long as the form looks good and there's a bit of sweetness, everyone will think it's a "good" anomaly.
Even the fact that this anomaly has harmed many can be conveniently forgotten. Now, hit me with the "Ohhhh don't be such a grumpy conspiracy theorist!" Which is fine! From now on, everything will be viewed from a positive angle, interpreted in a good light! Such positivity! Much love! Wowzers!
Ignorance really is bliss, huh.

"上课铃响第一声。
今天早上我叼着面包冲进教学楼时，绝对没想到自己会在走廊上表演滑稽戏，我在平地摔了个狗吃屎，当我龇牙咧嘴爬起来时，嘴里的面包早在我用脸刹车时，狠狠按印出一张绝望的「痛苦面具」。
上课铃响第五声。
来不及了！等冲到二楼拐角，更诡异的事情发生了。我的书包带突然被一股神秘力量拽住，整个人像被按在原地的木偶，一股无形的力量正在阻挠我前进！但我转头只能看见消防栓门在轻微晃动。教室明明近在眼前，我却感觉寸步难行，就像梦里奔跑时那种脱力感，一米距离延伸出万丈深渊的无力……
上课铃响第八声。
哈哈，反正快迟到了，慢慢来吧……走廊尽头的风纪委员已经在记我的名字咯，他扶了扶眼镜，问我为什么不进教室，要立在走廊中央和他对峙。同学……不是我不想走，我感觉我脚上有万钧之力。不是黏上了强力胶水！也不是我小腿抽筋！我发誓有一个「看不见的家伙」一直在拽着我。风纪委员又扶了扶眼镜，说这样的借口他听多了，从我说第一个字开始，他就不太相信。
上课铃响第九声。
风纪委员朝我走来……
上课铃响第十声。
风纪委员朝我滚来……
上课铃响第十二声
救救我和风纪委员，我们被一团看不见的东西，在走廊上撞成了两颗弹力球！！
上课铃响第十三声
万幸，终于进教室了。不过不是走正门……是从墙面撞穿进去了呢。
喂，风纪委员，先别管骨不骨折这件事了。右手还能动吧？先把我的名字从本子上划掉啊！铃响十三声前，都不能算我迟到吧？"

"First bell rings.
When I rushed into the school building this morning with bread in my mouth, I absolutely never imagined I'd be performing slapstick comedy in the hallway. I face-planted on flat ground, and when I grimaced and crawled back up, the bread in my mouth had already been smashed into a desperate mask of pain when I used my face to soften my fall…
Fifth bell rings.
I'm out of time! When I rushed to the second floor corner, something even weirder happened. My backpack strap was suddenly yanked by some mysterious force, making me feel like a puppet pinned in place. An invisible force was blocking my progress! Though when I turned around, all I could see was the fire extinguisher door swaying slightly. The classroom was clearly right in front of me, yet I felt like I couldn't move an inch—like that powerless feeling when you're running in a dream, where a one-meter distance stretches into an endless abyss of helplessness…
Eighth bell rings.
Haha, I'm already about to be late anyway, might as well take my time… The hall monitor at the end of the corridor is already writing down my name. He adjusted his glasses and asked why I wouldn't enter the classroom, why I was standing in the middle of the hallway confronting him. Dude… it's not that I don't want to walk, I feel like there's a massive weight on my feet. It's not super glue stuck to them! It's not a leg cramp either! I swear there's some invisible guy pulling on me. The hall monitor adjusted his glasses again, saying he'd heard this kind of excuse plenty of times, and he stopped believing me from the first word I said.
Ninth bell rings.
The hall monitor walks toward me…
Tenth bell rings.
The hall monitor rolls toward me…
Twelfth bell rings.
Someone save me and the hall monitor—we've been bounced around the hallway like two rubber balls by some invisible force!!
Thirteenth bell rings.
Thankfully, I finally made it into the classroom. Though not through the front door… I crashed through the wall.
Hey, hall monitor, don't worry about whether anything's broken. Your right hand still works, right? Cross my name off that list! I got in before the thirteenth bell, so it doesn't count as being late, right?"

……那些图纸，还有异象空间里那栋外立面上乱七八糟的建筑，背后并不简单。
做建筑设计的人，应该都知道是谁——或者说，是哪群人的手笔。
当年，就在海特洛市兴建高楼和商业街的阶段，有开发商炒作了一个概念：将把商业街所有建筑的外立面设计成一体的平面，这样就能投放巨屏的广告，一时引起了不小的讨论。有一位老派的建筑设计学者起头公开反对，觉得建筑设计应该服务于市民和城市景观，而不是给这些大公司打什么商业广告。
……你不知道也正常，毕竟那个概念最终也没能落地，说到底只是吸引眼球的噱头罢了……但那位较真的老先生却没停下，他一直不断地抨击这个概念，乃至整个设计行业……但从某天开始，他突然开始了长期休假，没有校内课程，也没有任何项目……最后，他不声不响地离开了设计学院。
没错。很多人都猜测，他受到了一些……来自行业的压力，但真相无人知晓。愤怒的学生们想搞清楚怎么回事，尝试联系他，却得不到任何回应。他们试图通过学校调查此事，也只是被拖延和忽视。
但最后，他们在学者办公桌抽屉的缝隙里，找到了一个没有被带走的信封，里面装着一张潦草的设计图纸，上面画着整条商业街的建筑，在每座建筑的外立面上布满了凹凸不平、毫不美观的结构，即便是水平最差的设计师也不会这么做。没人知道那是不是学者的手笔，也没人知道它究竟想传达什么意思……但你也看到了，那些变成异象的图纸，还有异象空间里的那座建筑，都继承了这种意义不明的设计……这是属于他们的一种暗号，也是他们给这座城市、给所有城市的报复。如果你看到哪座建筑上有这样的设计，就证明，有个幸运的家伙成功了。
……「空间艺术」？哈哈哈……也不知道是谁发明了这么牵强的说法，艺术这个词还真是好用……
但比起堆满城市、铺满广告的规整立方体，我还是更乐意看到这些丑「艺术」一些。

Those blueprints and that messy building facade in the Anomalous Realm… there's more to them than meets the eye.
Anyone in architectural design should know whose work that is, or rather, which group of people were behind it.
Back then, during Hethereau's high-rise and commercial district development phase, some developers hyped up a concept: they would design all the building facades on the commercial street as one unified plane, allowing them to project massive advertisements. It caused quite a stir at the time. An old-school architectural design scholar took the lead in publicly opposing it, believing that architectural design should serve citizens and the urban landscape, not advertisment for these big corporations.
It's normal that you don't know about it. After all, that concept never actually came to fruition. It was just an attention-grabbing gimmick at the end of the day… But that stubborn old gentleman didn't stop there. He kept attacking the concept, and eventually the entire design industry… One day, he suddenly took extended leave with no campus courses or projects… Eventually, he quietly left the design academy.
That's right. Many people suspected he faced some… pressure from the industry, but no one really knows the truth. Angry students wanted to figure out what happened and tried to contact him, but got no response. They attempted to investigate through the school, but were only met with delays and dismissal.
But in the end, they found an envelope that hadn't been taken away, stuck in a gap in the scholar's office desk drawer. Inside was a roughly sketched design drawing showing the entire commercial street, with every building's facade covered in uneven, unsightly structures. Even the worst designer wouldn't do something like that. No one knew if it was the scholar's work, or what it was trying to convey… But as you've seen, those blueprints that became Anomalies, and that building in the Anomalous Realm, they all inherited this incomprehensible design… It's their kind of secret code, and their revenge against this city, against all cities. If you see any building with this kind of design, it proves that some lucky guy succeeded.
"Spatial art"? Hahaha… I wonder who invented such a far-fetched term. The word "art" sure is convenient…
But compared to the orderly cubes packed with cities and covered in advertisements, I'd rather see more of these ugly "artworks."

……
鲸的发声器官，硬骨鱼的鳍和尾，水母的腕足……那不是这个世界的生物，那是许多摞叠在一起的生命符号，一个来自这片海洋所有「生灵」的警示。
至于那些凭空出现的锁链，尺寸异常的船锚，还有那片血红色的海……我找不到一个科学的解释（好吧，这在海特洛是常有的事），总之，就算是为了海底隧道的安全考虑，这也是个非常值得研究的对象。
……
会议上的那群家伙真是毫无水准，单听了几个被吓到的异象猎人的一面之词就妄下定论！要是他们亲眼见过它，绝不会说出「一头渴望复仇的野兽」这种蠢话。它那些有韵律的鲸歌显然是示好的标志，听不懂是他们的问题。但那些发狂般的攻击行为到底是怎么回事……这是我的专业领域，我会搞清楚的。
……
我尝试把两组大型音箱绑在了车顶，在去往异象空间通道中播放鲸鱼的叫声，我真是个天才。它听到后明显给出了友善的回应，并表露出好奇。如果我没会错意的话，这个交友计划应该成功了。
……
每次都是这样……进入异象空间一段时间后，海水就会开始变红，船锚和锁链从天而降，然后你开始失控地攻击身边的一切……可这究竟是为什么？这是你在宣泄怒火吗？还是你的噩梦的具象表现？可如果真是那样，又为何你看上去那么痛苦……我到底该怎么帮你……
…… 
该死的，我终于弄清楚了，你的背上插着一把该死的捕鲸叉，它很不对劲，那绝不是普通的东西，起码现在不是，我非常怀疑那也是一个异象……或许那就是这一切的原因。我会想办法的。
……
我已经决定好了，无论如何，这都会是我这辈子干过的最冒险的事。
我要像个英雄或者蠢货那样去见你，用音箱大声放着鲸歌交响乐，然后登上你的身体，把那碍眼的捕鲸叉给拔出来，或者挖出来，又或者泯除掉，最终让这里的海水变蓝——管他呢，总有办法。
祝你自由！祝我成功！

…
A whale's vocal organs, the fins and tail of bony fish, the arms of jellyfish… That isn't a creature from this world. It's many life symbols stacked together, a warning from all the living beings of this ocean.
As for those chains appearing out of nowhere, the abnormally sized ship anchors, and that blood-red sea… I can't find a scientific explanation (well, that's pretty common in Hethereau). Anyway, even if just for the safety of the undersea tunnel, this is definitely a subject worth studying.
…
Those idiots in the meeting have absolutely no standards, jumping to conclusions just from hearing one-sided accounts from a few scared Anomaly Hunters! If they'd seen it with their own eyes, they would never say something as stupid as "a beast thirsting for revenge." Its rhythmic whale songs are clearly signs of friendliness. If they can't understand that, it's their problem. But what's with those frenzied attack behaviors…? This is my area of expertise. I'll figure it out.
…
I tried strapping two large speakers to my car roof and playing whale calls while heading to the Anomalous Realm passage. I'm a genius. It responded clearly in a friendly manner, showing curiosity. If I'm reading it right, this friendship plan was a success.
…
It's always the same… After being in the Anomalous Realm for a while, the seawater starts turning red, anchors and chains fall from the sky, and then you start attacking everything around you out of control… But why? Are you venting your anger? Is this a manifestation of your nightmares? If that's the case, why do you look so pained…? How can I help…?
…
Damn it, I finally figured it out. There's a damn harpoon stuck in your back. Something's very wrong with it. That's definitely not an ordinary object, at least not anymore. I strongly suspect that's also an Anomaly… Maybe that's the cause of all this? I'll find a way to fix it.
…
I've made up my mind. This will be the most dangerous thing I've ever done in my life…
I'm going to meet you either as a hero or a fool, blasting whale song symphonies through my speakers… Then I'll climb onto your body and pull out that eyesore of a harpoon, or dig it out, or nullify it, and finally turn the seawater here blue again! Whatever it takes, there's got to be a way.
Here's to your freedom! Here's to my success!

听说有人会专门去找「囿巢鸟」的巢，企图从它的巢里捞点宝贝出来。故事里不是说，「囿巢鸟」只顾着搜罗金丝银线来筑巢，才疏忽了自己的子女吗？它的巢里肯定堆满了珠宝首饰！

I've heard that some people go out of their way to find the Nestbound Bird's nest, hoping to score some treasure. Doesn't the story go that the Nestbound Bird was so busy collecting gold and silver thread for its nest that it neglected its own children? That nest must be overflowing with jewels and riches!
Pah, only someone who's never dealt with the Nestbound Bird would believe such nonsense. One look inside its nest and you'll know the truth.
There's nothing there but despair.
Maybe that's a bit dramatic. Let me put it this way: the only materials used to build that nest are emptiness and heartbreak. Anyone who's heard that bird's mournful, pitiful cries would find it hard not to shed a tear. Even so, we can't show it any mercy. We must carry out Nullification, for the sake of all the families it has torn apart, for all the children who lost themselves after being lured away.
…
And for my own child.

Maybe I'm the only one who thinks this way: to carry out Nullification, to end its suffering… perhaps that too is a form of kindness.

这么多年了，还有人来问那个都市传说？
对，「蝶」是我同学。她很安静，成绩也不错，家庭也和睦。普通人家的乖孩子——如果普通的人生有一个折中的模板，前十几年就应该是她那样。
不知道哪天起，她开始逃课。一开始没人觉得她会逃课，都觉得她病了，只是忘记请假。老师也这么觉得，直到第三天老师联系上她家长，才知道她根本没病。后来他们去新赫兰德的电影院把她抓回来了。没过两天她还是逃课，所以她又被家长带走，关在家里反省。大家都觉得她迟早会回来，试卷给她照留一份，直到她的抽屉、桌面、椅子上都堆满，大家才反应过来，她大概不会再回来了。
当然有不好的猜想，可是没有任何消息和证据，我们也不确定究竟发生了什么。老师说她逃课是去看电影，票根装了一书包。第一次看到斑蝶的时候，它的骨架在风里窸窸窣窣地响，我想起老师拎起小蝶书包的时候，票根从里面落下来，也是窸窸窣窣。
毕业那天，我想去收拾一下小蝶的东西，书、试卷、票根，至少帮她保存好。到了却发现那儿什么都没有。查了监控，是被不认识的人拿去当废品卖了。大概卖不了几个方斯，换不成半张电影票。
抱歉，扯远了。还有什么要问的吗？
「空」？我回忆一下……我们班没有叫这个的人，名字里带空字的也没有。嗯，我确定。

After all these years, people are still asking about that urban legend?
Yes, Butterfly was my classmate. She was quiet, got good grades, and had a happy family. A well-behaved kid from an ordinary household. If there were a template for an average life, her first dozen years would have been exactly that.
One day, she started skipping class. At first, no one thought she would ever skip. Everyone assumed she was sick and just forgot to call in. The teacher thought so too, until they finally reached her parents on the third day and found out she wasn't sick at all. They went to the cinema in New Herland and dragged her back. Two days later, she skipped again, so her parents took her home and made her reflect on her actions. Everyone thought she'd come back eventually. They kept setting aside test papers for her, until her drawer, her desk, and her chair were all piled high. Only then did it dawn on everyone that she probably wasn't coming back.
Of course there were dark assumptions, but without any news or evidence, we couldn't be sure what actually happened. The teacher said she was skipping class to watch movies. Her backpack was stuffed with ticket stubs. The first time I saw Swallowtail, its skeletal frame rustling in the wind… It reminded me of when the teacher picked up Little Butterfly's backpack, and the ticket stubs rustling out just the same.
On graduation day, I wanted to sort through Little Butterfly's things. Her books, test papers, and ticket stubs. At least keep them safe for her. But when I got there, everything was gone. I checked the security footage. Someone I didn't recognize had taken it all to sell as scrap. Probably didn't get more than a few Fons. Not even enough for half a movie ticket.
Sorry, I got off track. Anything else you want to ask?
"Sky"? Let me think… There was no one by that name in our class. No one with that character in their name either. Yeah, I'm sure.

"我不是来找你们处理异象的——我自己就是异象猎人！别看我现在这样，手底下可还带着好几个新人呢……虽然他们确实是菜了点，但这种程度的异象，哪用得着求助你们管理局啊。
「过期请柬」这个异象，你们听说过吧？我第一次遇见它是四五年前的事了。那时刚入行，运气不太好，接连几天没生意。眼见着卡里余额见底，马上要吃不起饭，看见「猎人帮」挂出新委托，想都没想就接单了。结果到了任务地点，才发现这东西难对付得很，以我当时的水平根本搞不定。被它打到狼狈逃跑了几次，反倒激发了我的好胜心。好在这个委托不限时，我每天除了打几只小虾米挣个饭钱，剩下的时间全用来研究「过期请柬」。就这么折腾了大半个月，终于，我找到了「过期请柬」存在的真正意义。
你们想啊——一碰就进异象空间，一进异象空间就被围攻，但是想逃跑也不难，没什么大风险。逃走后它就会变回火漆的模样，但下次再去的时候又会重新触发。这不就是个永远打不坏、还会自我修复的活靶子吗？太适合给人练手了！想明白这一点之后，我就想办法说服了原本的委托方，把它保留下来，租给刚入行的异象猎人当训练工具。生意可红火了，它为我赚的方斯早就超过了当初的委托金。每天都有新人来找我租这个「过期请柬」，虽然他们老调侃我说「这世界上要真有恶魔，每只恶魔身上都得有你的纹身」……但我是真的很穷啊！想赚钱，不寒碜！
……所以，我的诉求？呃，我不是说了吗？我不是想泯除异象，就是想打听打听，你们知不知道哪儿还有别的「过期请柬」啊？这两天，我租出去的那个被一个毛头小子手滑泯除了……现在大伙都找不着这么好使又便宜的靶子了。所以我就……欸，我话还没说完呢！"

"I'm not here asking you to deal with Anomalies. I'm an Anomaly Hunter myself! Don't let my current appearance fool you, I've got several rookies under me… Sure, they're pretty green, but for this level of Anomaly, why would I need to ask the Bureau for help?
You've heard of the Expired Invitation Anomaly, right? I first encountered it about four or five years ago. I was new to the business back then, and my luck wasn't great. I'd gone several days without any work. My account was nearly empty, and I was about to go hungry when I saw Hyelp post a new commission. I didn't even think twice before accepting it. When I got to the quest location, I realized this thing was incredibly tough to deal with. My skill level back then wasn't nearly enough to handle it. After getting beaten and having to flee embarrassingly several times, it actually sparked my competitive spirit. Luckily, this commission had no time limit, so every day I'd take down a few small fry to earn meal money, then spend the rest of my time studying the Expired Invitation. After messing around with it for over half a month, I finally discovered the true purpose of the Expired Invitation.
Think about it: touch it and you enter the Anomalous Realm, enter the Realm and you get swarmed. Escaping isn't that hard though, so there's no real risk. After you escape, it turns back into a wax seal… but the next time you go there, it triggers again. Isn't that just an indestructible, self-repairing target dummy? Perfect for practice! Once I figured this out, I managed to convince the original client to let me keep it and rent it out to rookie Anomaly Hunters as a training tool. Business was booming! The Fons it earned me far exceeded the original commission fee. Every day, rookies would come to rent this 'Expired Invitation' from me. Sure, they'd always tease me saying 'If there really are demons in this world, every demon would have your tattoo on them'… but I was really broke! Wanting to make money isn't shameful!
…So, my request? Uh, didn't I already say? I don't want to nullify the Anomaly. I just want to ask around and see if you know where there might be other Expired Invitations. A couple days ago, some rookie accidentally nullified the one I was renting out… Now everyone can't use such a versitile and cheap practice tool. So I… Hey, I wasn't finished talking yet!"

我见过这幅画，也进过那片奇异的空间。它是在借用谜题传达自己的理念，很特立独行的异象。
视觉并不映照世界，它转述世界。经过神经传递重新成像的光线已经不是原来的那束光线。我们的视觉不过是另一块画布，大脑用眼睛接收来的颜料重新作画。颜色是光线的折射，形体是脑部的重构，我们从来都「看」不到真正的真实，也正因如此，我们与生俱来地拥有在画布上寻找真实的能力。
而这个异象用它错落的拼接告诉我们，幻觉的构建是如此令人着迷。梦境中的景象总是以一种光怪陆离的方式组合在一起，而在异象里，我们能够在清醒的状态下实现这一过程——凡在外形上能够联系的，就可组合在一起。这种组合方式突破了物体本质的禁锢，它们以纯粹的形象获得全新的可能。艺术家眼中的世界是自由的。
对了，听说这位画家的作品存世不少？有谁能帮忙联系到收购渠道吗？我很想收藏一幅，价钱任你开！

I've seen this painting and entered that strange space. It uses puzzles to convey its concepts. A very unique Anomaly.
Vision doesn't reflect the world, it retells it. Light that has been reprocessed through neural transmission is no longer the same beam of light. Our vision is just another canvas, and our brain repaints using the pigments received by our eyes. Colors are refractions of light, forms are reconstructions by the brain. We can never truly see real reality, and precisely because of this, we're born with the ability to seek reality on canvas.
This Anomaly tells us through its fragmented assemblage how fascinating the construction of illusion can be. Scenes in dreams always combine in bizarre and fantastic ways, and within the Anomaly, we can achieve this process while awake. Anything that can be visually connected can be combined together. This method of combination breaks free from the constraints of an object's essence, allowing them to envision new possibilities through pure imagery. The world in an artist's eyes is free.
By the way, I heard this artist has quite a few surviving works? Can anyone help me get in touch with acquisition channels? I'd really love to collect one. Name your price!

小时候，奶奶曾给我讲过这样一个睡前故事。
在她读书时，学校组织过一场春游。全班同学都兴奋不已——毕竟对学生来说，不用上课的活动总是好玩的！她和住在附近的朋友一路聊着明天要带的零食、想拍的照片……刚回到家，她就迫不及待地收拾好背包，还定了三个闹钟，生怕睡过头。可到了傍晚，天色却越来越阴沉。大人们都说，看这积雨云的厚度，大雨恐怕要下上一天一夜。如果第二天早晨雨还不停，春游就要取消了……奶奶在惴惴不安中爬上床。
夜里，果然下起雨来，闪电把整个房间照得雪亮。她沮丧地望着窗外，很久很久，雨没有任何将要停歇的迹象。在即将失去春游机会的失落中，她突然想起了关于「扫晴娘」的传说——据说这种异象可以吸收雨水，让晴天更早到来。虽然在那之前她也从未亲眼见过，但本着抓住最后一根救命稻草的心情，她还是对着立在墙角的拖把双手合十，虔诚祈祷：「扫晴娘」，帮帮我，让天早早放晴吧！
奶奶说，当时自己也觉得这种行为很愚蠢——拖把终究只是拖把而已，不是那种传说中的异象。而且，就算「扫晴娘」真能听到她的愿望，这种小小的异象又怎么能真的改变天候呢？和拖把大眼瞪小眼了一阵，她被尴尬打垮了，羞于多看它一眼，赶紧躲回被窝里蒙住头，不愿相信自己真的做出了这么幼稚的行为。
不知不觉，她睡着了……然后，不知又过了多久，一阵雷声从地平线那边滚过来，把奶奶惊醒了。看来雨果然越下越大了，她失落地爬出被窝，望向窗外——
隔着玻璃，她望见了滂沱大雨，和数不清的「扫晴娘」。雨点敲打在她们的雨披上，发出银铃般清脆的声响。轰鸣的雷声化作了有节奏的鼓点，为她们伴奏。无数个「扫晴娘」的叮咚声连绵交织，形成一串清越、和谐又温柔的旋律，涟漪一样在夜空中荡开。
那是一个神奇的……梦幻般的场面。那些洁白的异象们就像一尾尾小鱼，乘着连接天地的雨水逆流而上，不断向天空游去。她不知道她们究竟从何而来，是否听到了她的愿望，这之后又将去向何处，更不确定她们是否真有能力唤来晴天——但至少那夜剩下的时间里，奶奶在「扫晴娘」柔和的「歌声」里睡了个好觉。
至于第二天到底有没有放晴……没等听到结局，我就已经睡着了，所以至今也不得而知。但我想，天气如何或许并不重要。那个雨夜所见的奇迹般的景象，一定比某个寻常的晴天更令人难以忘怀吧。

When I was little, my grandmother once told me a bedtime story like this.
When she was in school, her class was planning a spring field trip. All her classmates were buzzing with excitement. After all, any activity that meant skipping class is always fun! On the way home, she and a friend who lived nearby chatted about what snacks to bring and what photos they wanted to take. The moment she got home, she could not wait to pack her bag and set three alarms, terrified of oversleeping. But by evening, the sky grew darker and darker. The adults all said that judging by the thickness of the cumulonimbus clouds, the heavy rain would probably last a whole day and night! If it was still raining by the morning, the field trip would be canceled… Grandma climbed into bed, her heart full of worry.
That night, just as expected, the rain began to fall. Lightning lit up her entire room bright as day. She stared glumly out the window for what felt like forever, but the rain showed no sign of letting up. Faced with losing her chance at the field trip, she suddenly remembered the legend of the Rain-sweeping Maid. It was said that this Anomaly could absorb rainwater and make clear skies come sooner. She'd never actually seen one before, but desperately she put her palms together. She faced toward the mop standing in the corner of her room and prayed with all her heart: Rain-sweeping Maid, please help me! Let the weather clear up soon!
Grandma said that even at the time, she felt silly doing it. A mop was just a mop, after all. It was not one of those Anomalies. Even if the Rain-sweeping Maid could somehow hear her wish, could such a small Anomaly actually change the weather? After staring at the mop awkwardly for a while, she was defeated by embarrassment. Too ashamed to look at it any longer, she hurried back under the covers and pulled them over her head, refusing to believe she had really done something so childish.
Before she knew it, she fell asleep… Then, after what could have been any amount of time, a roll of thunder from beyond the horizon jolted her awake. The rain must've gotten even heavier. Disappointed, she crawled out of bed and looked toward the window…
Through the glass, she saw the pouring rain, and countless Rain-sweeping Maid. Raindrops struck their raincoats, making a sound as clear and crisp as silver bells. The rumbling thunder transformed into rhythmic drumbeats, accompanying them. The chiming of countless Rain-sweeping Maid intertwined into a melody, clear, harmonious, and gentle, rippling outward across the night sky.
It was a wondrous… dreamlike scene. Those pure white Anomalies were like little fish, riding the rain that connected heaven and earth, swimming ever upward toward the sky. She did not know where they had come from, whether they had heard her wish, or where they would go afterward. She wasn't even sure if they truly had the power to bring clear skies… but for the rest of that night, Grandma slept soundly, lulled by the gentle song of the Rain-sweeping Maid.
As for whether the next day actually turned out sunny… I fell asleep before hearing the ending, so to this day, I still do not know. But I think the weather might not matter. The miracle on that rainy night must have been far more unforgettable than any ordinary sunny day.

算不上麻烦的异象，通常情况下冲进去收拾一顿就行。但即使如此，每次接到这种委托，我们组所有人都会变得格外谦让有礼，彼此推辞，最终只能由抽签决定哪个倒霉蛋撞此大运。
你应该知道「灵感终结者」制造的异象空间，是根据它吸取到的灵感夸张变化来的吧？也就是说，那玩意可以说是一个超巨型点子具象化主题乐园。往那儿一站，你就知道被偷点子的那人究竟在想什么。
这可完全称不上有趣，这么跟你说吧：那时我接到了我最崇拜的漫画家下的委托，如果不帮她解决这个大麻烦，连载的结尾可就……总之带着可以帮到偶像的虔诚惶恐的心情，我踏进了异象空间，结果发现那就是由她酝酿的最后一话的「灵感」生成的。猝不及防，我被提前剧透了个干干净净……追连载时的期待，和别人讨论伏笔时的激动，属于这部作品所有的满足感……就这样草率又仓促的碎掉了。本该……我本该和其他朋友们一起庆祝它迎来最后一话，既幸福又不舍地慢慢读完这个故事……
咳咳，扯远了。不管怎么说，这个根据人们灵感生成的异象空间，甚至比其他异象弄出来的还要复杂。如果灵感主人是恐怖片导演，恭喜你将收获一段永生难忘的惊魂体验。我有位同事，差点迷失在推理小说家的灵感空间里，属实把人吓得不轻。这能算工伤吗？
对了，还有最重要的一点。通常我们会被要求签一些保密协议、合同啊什么的。毕竟我们是除了委托人以外唯一知道这个想法的人。虽说可以理解，但条条框框的就是很烦人啊？委托费算不上高，规矩倒一个不少！谁乐意接这种活嘛……

These Anomalies aren't usually troublesome—just a quick cleanup. But when we get these commissions, everyone tries to pass them off until we draw lots.
You probably know that the Anomalous Realms they create are like warped theme parks of the stolen inspiration. One step in there and you'll know exactly what was going on in the victim's head.
It's not as fun as it sounds. I once helped my favorite manga artist and got the ultimate spoiler for her series' ending. All the anticipation and excitement, gone in an instant. I was looking forward to celebrating the final chapter with my friends and savoring the story's end…
Sorry, got carried away there. These realms can be more complex than others. If the inspiration's owner is a horror director, you're in for an unforgettable nightmare. A colleague nearly got lost in a mystery novelist's realm and was freaking out. Would that count as a workplace injury?
We also have to sign NDAs and contracts, which is a pain. The commission fee isn't high, but the regulations are endless. No wonder nobody wants these jobs…

有没有人和我一样，莫名其妙地对电梯感到敬畏？
指的不是搭电梯会恶心的症状，也不是那种经历过被困电梯的心理创伤。
我对于坐车坐飞机之类都不会有这种感受，哪怕载具是封闭的，我依然可以透过窗户认知到外界。但是，电梯就并非如此了。
可能是因为我从小就比较喜欢胡思乱想吧，再加上我们的世界里还有异象这类存在，就总会寻思着……电梯门的开启，像不像在打开一个未知世界的盲盒？
噢，虽说电梯轿厢本身才是更小的那个盒子。

比方说，我想象过在电梯门打开时——
定点发射的灾难性激光已将我的家和全部财产化为瓦砾。
洪水冲进来将我卷走睁眼便可无缝衔接汪洋孤岛漂流生活。
变成丧尸的父母一个跳脸猛然扑到面前对着我张开血盆大口。
一脚踏进外面毫无异状的风景中却不知是真空的假象，于是在失重的飘浮感中被碾碎或是撑裂，再次睁开眼睛一个头发花白满身科学仪器的老头告诉我「实验结束了」。
……当然也不无可能是一个水灵灵大眼睛的美少女带着热情的笑容站在门外来恭喜我转生到奇幻异世界了，总之现在从lv.1和最烂的初始技能配置开始努力成为拯救世界的勇者吧。

以上这些妄想全部都没有发生过，但我对电梯的敬畏之心丝毫没有因日常所赋予的麻痹感而减缓。
独自一人搭乘电梯这种事，确实是日常生活中我们所最经常能接触到的……将自己得以暂时隔绝在全世界之外的时段吧。在那些微小不连续但又极其频繁的碎片中，我被装进盲盒，外界被装进盲盒，我无法证明外界的一如往常，而外界失去我——这么想，其实感觉还挺不错的。
啊，尤其是在这个电梯里完全没有信号导致我的呗果也发不出去的时候，这类妄想的效果更是代入感极强。
就像现在，我一个人在这，电梯门似乎莫名其妙地被卡住了，氧气倒是够，就是按了好久呼叫也没反应。所以只能闲得在手机上写起这种随笔……只是一次电梯的时间本来是绝不可能写这么多感想的啊。难得写了这么多，就等有信号了再发布出去好了。
话说这儿还有个「紧急启动」的按钮，说不定能把电梯门打开？我从来没有按过这类按钮，没有网络现在也没法搜索这种情况下用这个安不安全……
临场感太给劲了，这是我最紧张的一次。

……

在现场电梯轿厢回收到的手机，呗果app草稿箱中发现了这篇文稿。
轿厢内没有血迹和争斗痕迹。电梯内摄像头录像模糊显示当事人在电梯门打开后，先是一愣，后小心翼翼地走出门外，约一刻钟后返回电梯内，主动将手机留下，在向摄像头方位挥手致意后，再次踏入电梯之外。
当事人因「层级增生」异象突发在其所搭乘的电梯中而最终下落不明，推测迷失于其中某一层异象空间。

Does anyone else feel an inexplicable sense of awe toward elevators?
I'm not talking about getting motion sick in elevators, nor psychological trauma from being trapped in one.
I don't feel this way about cars or planes. Even in enclosed vehicles, I can still perceive the outside world through windows. Elevators… are different.
Maybe it's because I've always had an overactive imagination, and with Anomalies existing in our world, I can't help but wonder… When the elevator doors open, isn't it like opening a Mystery Box to an unknown world?
Oh, though technically the elevator car itself is the smaller box.

For example, I've imagined the elevator doors opening to find:
A precision strike laser has reduced my home and all my belongings to rubble.
A flood rushes in and sweeps me away, and when I open my eyes, I seamlessly transition into a deserted island survival situation.
My zombified parents lunging at my face with their gaping, bloody maws.
I step out into a perfectly normal-looking scene, unaware it's actually a vacuum, and I'm crushed or torn apart in the sensation of weightlessness, only to open my eyes again as some white-haired old man covered in scientific instruments tells me, "The experiment is over."
…Of course, there's also the possibility of a bright-eyed pretty girl standing outside with an enthusiastic smile, congratulating me on being reincarnated into a fantasy world, where I'll start from Lvl 1 with the worst possible skills and work my way up to becoming the hero who saves the world.

None of these delusions have ever come true, but my sense of awe toward elevators hasn't diminished one bit even after using them so often.
Riding an elevator alone is probably the most frequent opportunity in daily life to temporarily isolate oneself from the rest of the world… In those tiny, fleeting yet extremely frequent fragments of time, I'm placed in a Mystery Box. The outside world too is placed in a Mystery Box, and I can't prove it remains as it was, and it loses me. When I think about it that way, it actually feels pretty nice.
Ah, especially when there's absolutely no signal in this elevator and I can't even post on Bagel, these delusions become incredibly immersive.
Like right now. I'm alone here, the elevator doors seem to be inexplicably stuck, there's enough oxygen at least, but pressing the call button for ages hasn't gotten any response. So, I'm bored enough to write this rambling essay on my phone… though normally, a single elevator ride would never be long enough to write this much. Since I've written so much, I'll just post it once I get signals again.
By the way, there's an "Emergency Start" button here. Maybe it could open the elevator doors? I've never pressed a button like this before, and without internet, I can't look up whether it's safe to use in this situation…
The sense of presence is incredible. This is the most nervous I've ever been.

…

Addendum:
This manuscript was discovered in the drafts folder of the Bagel app on a phone recovered from the elevator car at the scene.
No bloodstains or signs of struggle were found inside the car. Blurry footage from the elevator's security camera shows the subject pausing in surprise when the elevator doors opened, then cautiously stepping outside. They returned to the elevator approximately fifteen minutes later, deliberately left their phone behind, waved toward the camera, and stepped outside the elevator once more.
The subject's current whereabouts are unknown after the Level Proliferation Anomaly manifested in the elevator they were riding. It is presumed they became lost in one of the floors of the Anomalous Realm…

小时候，奶奶曾给我讲过这样一个睡前故事。
在她读书时，学校组织过一场春游。全班同学都兴奋不已——毕竟对学生来说，不用上课的活动总是好玩的！她和住在附近的朋友一路聊着明天要带的零食、想拍的照片……刚回到家，她就迫不及待地收拾好背包，还定了三个闹钟，生怕睡过头。可到了傍晚，天色却越来越阴沉。大人们都说，看这积雨云的厚度，大雨恐怕要下上一天一夜。如果第二天早晨雨还不停，春游就要取消了……奶奶在惴惴不安中爬上床。
夜里，果然下起雨来，闪电把整个房间照得雪亮。她沮丧地望着窗外，很久很久，雨没有任何将要停歇的迹象。在即将失去春游机会的失落中，她突然想起了关于「扫晴娘」的传说——据说这种异象可以吸收雨水，让晴天更早到来。虽然在那之前她也从未亲眼见过，但本着抓住最后一根救命稻草的心情，她还是对着立在墙角的拖把双手合十，虔诚祈祷：「扫晴娘」，帮帮我，让天早早放晴吧！
奶奶说，当时自己也觉得这种行为很愚蠢——拖把终究只是拖把而已，不是那种传说中的异象。而且，就算「扫晴娘」真能听到她的愿望，这种小小的异象又怎么能真的改变天候呢？和拖把大眼瞪小眼了一阵，她被尴尬打垮了，羞于多看它一眼，赶紧躲回被窝里蒙住头，不愿相信自己真的做出了这么幼稚的行为。
不知不觉，她睡着了……然后，不知又过了多久，一阵雷声从地平线那边滚过来，把奶奶惊醒了。看来雨果然越下越大了，她失落地爬出被窝，望向窗外——
隔着玻璃，她望见了滂沱大雨，和数不清的「扫晴娘」。雨点敲打在她们的雨披上，发出银铃般清脆的声响。轰鸣的雷声化作了有节奏的鼓点，为她们伴奏。无数个「扫晴娘」的叮咚声连绵交织，形成一串清越、和谐又温柔的旋律，涟漪一样在夜空中荡开。
那是一个神奇的……梦幻般的场面。那些洁白的异象们就像一尾尾小鱼，乘着连接天地的雨水逆流而上，不断向天空游去。她不知道她们究竟从何而来，是否听到了她的愿望，这之后又将去向何处，更不确定她们是否真有能力唤来晴天——但至少那夜剩下的时间里，奶奶在「扫晴娘」柔和的「歌声」里睡了个好觉。
至于第二天到底有没有放晴……没等听到结局，我就已经睡着了，所以至今也不得而知。但我想，天气如何或许并不重要。那个雨夜所见的奇迹般的景象，一定比某个寻常的晴天更令人难以忘怀吧。

When I was little, my grandmother once told me a bedtime story like this.
When she was in school, her class was planning a spring field trip. All her classmates were buzzing with excitement. After all, any activity that meant skipping class is always fun! On the way home, she and a friend who lived nearby chatted about what snacks to bring and what photos they wanted to take. The moment she got home, she could not wait to pack her bag and set three alarms, terrified of oversleeping. But by evening, the sky grew darker and darker. The adults all said that judging by the thickness of the cumulonimbus clouds, the heavy rain would probably last a whole day and night! If it was still raining by the morning, the field trip would be canceled… Grandma climbed into bed, her heart full of worry.
That night, just as expected, the rain began to fall. Lightning lit up her entire room bright as day. She stared glumly out the window for what felt like forever, but the rain showed no sign of letting up. Faced with losing her chance at the field trip, she suddenly remembered the legend of the Rain-sweeping Maid. It was said that this Anomaly could absorb rainwater and make clear skies come sooner. She'd never actually seen one before, but desperately she put her palms together. She faced toward the mop standing in the corner of her room and prayed with all her heart: Rain-sweeping Maid, please help me! Let the weather clear up soon!
Grandma said that even at the time, she felt silly doing it. A mop was just a mop, after all. It was not one of those Anomalies. Even if the Rain-sweeping Maid could somehow hear her wish, could such a small Anomaly actually change the weather? After staring at the mop awkwardly for a while, she was defeated by embarrassment. Too ashamed to look at it any longer, she hurried back under the covers and pulled them over her head, refusing to believe she had really done something so childish.
Before she knew it, she fell asleep… Then, after what could have been any amount of time, a roll of thunder from beyond the horizon jolted her awake. The rain must've gotten even heavier. Disappointed, she crawled out of bed and looked toward the window…
Through the glass, she saw the pouring rain, and countless Rain-sweeping Maid. Raindrops struck their raincoats, making a sound as clear and crisp as silver bells. The rumbling thunder transformed into rhythmic drumbeats, accompanying them. The chiming of countless Rain-sweeping Maid intertwined into a melody, clear, harmonious, and gentle, rippling outward across the night sky.
It was a wondrous… dreamlike scene. Those pure white Anomalies were like little fish, riding the rain that connected heaven and earth, swimming ever upward toward the sky. She did not know where they had come from, whether they had heard her wish, or where they would go afterward. She wasn't even sure if they truly had the power to bring clear skies… but for the rest of that night, Grandma slept soundly, lulled by the gentle song of the Rain-sweeping Maid.
As for whether the next day actually turned out sunny… I fell asleep before hearing the ending, so to this day, I still do not know. But I think the weather might not matter. The miracle on that rainy night must have been far more unforgettable than any ordinary sunny day.

嗯，我见过他，是在医院的一个角落里。
……异象委托？我不知道。
我当时在医院里抓「*獭麻吉」，突然接收到了一个奇怪的电波，有的段落空空的，像断片了一样，有的全是嘁嘁喳喳的杂音。我顺着方向找过去，就遇到了他。他也发现了我，电波里没有敌意，只是杂音变得更多了，有点像老电视的雪花屏。
嗯，他和我说了噩梦和废弃医院的事，我很感兴趣，就同意了他的请求。
「去寻找所有的真相」。
是个很神奇的过程，我只是闭上眼睛，等四周安静下来，睁眼后，就已经站在那座废弃医院的大厅了。
噢？你也对里面的事感兴趣吗？
嗯……该从何说起呢，里面有很多房间，看得见的，看不见的……还有一些像绷带组成的歧骸，它们一直在找我，也一直散发着充满恶意的电波。我感觉它们像是那座医院的一部分，包括那些恶意也是。
是有一些文件，但我没太留意，只是顺手带上，跟着感觉走，顺便和路上的歧骸捉迷藏。
是二楼的档案室，在那里可以得到他需要的「真相」，然后安全离开。
三楼和四楼……我没找到上去的路线，但我能感觉到一些很……怪异的电波，我不清楚那是什么。
嗯，肯定不止一个。
具体的见闻和路线……我倒是可以告诉你，但你确定要听吗？不会觉得被剧透吗？
噢，我还以为，你问我这些，是因为自己也想去一趟呢。
很可怕吗？我感觉还好吧，我还挺喜欢那个氛围的。可能是因为我在恐怖片里见过类似的——噢，也可能是因为我能感受到它们的电波，它们只要靠近了，我就有心理准备……这么一说，有点遗憾。
对了，如果你真的想去的话，告诉你一个只有老手才知道的规律，也是我通关的秘诀……
它们真的不会开柜子。

*注释：档案员已确认，「獭麻吉」是采访对象游玩的电子宠物游戏中的专有名词，并非异象或人名。

Yeah, I've seen him. It was in a corner of the hospital.
…Anomaly Commission? I don't know about that.
I was in the hospital catching Tamagochi* when I suddenly picked up this weird signal. Some parts were completely static gaps, and others were full of chattering noise. I followed the direction and ran into him, and he noticed me too. There was no hostility in the signal, just more noise, kind of like the snow on old TV screens.
Yeah, he told me about nightmares and the abandoned hospital. I was really interested, so I agreed to his request.
"Go find all the truths."
It was a really amazing process. I just closed my eyes, waited for everything around me to quiet down, and when I opened them, I was already standing in the lobby of that abandoned hospital…
Oh? Are you interested in what's inside too?
Hmm… where do I even start? There are lots of rooms inside, visible ones and invisible ones… and some oddities made of bandages. They were always looking for me and constantly emitting signals full of malice. I felt like they were part of that hospital, including all that malice.
There were some documents, but I didn't pay much attention. I just grabbed them as I went, followed my instincts, and played hide and seek with the oddities along the way.
It's the records room on the second floor. You can get the "truth" he needs there, then leave safely.
Third and fourth floors… I couldn't find a way up, but I could sense some really… strange signals. Not sure what they were.
Yeah, there's definitely more than one.
The specific details and routes… I could tell you, but are you sure you want to hear? Won't you feel spoiled?
Oh, I thought you were asking me all this because you wanted to go there yourself.
Is it scary? I thought it was alright, I actually kind of liked the atmosphere. Maybe because I've seen similar stuff in horror movies… or maybe because I can sense their signals? Whenever they get close, I'm mentally prepared… come to think of it, that's kind of a shame.
Oh right, if you really want to go, here's something only veterans know, and it's my secret to clearing it…
They really can't open cabinets.

*Note: The archivist has confirmed that "Tamagochi" is a concept from the interviewee's virtual pet game and is not an Anomaly or a person's name.

比起「黑之书」本身，我觉得还是滥用这种异象的人更可恶！之前就是这样，有人声称「只要跟随黑之书学习，就能掌握魔法」「魔法是比异能更强大的力量，应该属于每个人」，用这一套说辞骗了好多好多人！
……嗯，你问我是怎么确定他是骗子的？啊哈哈……这个说起来有点不太好意思……欸，非说不可吗？
……其实是因为黑之书上印着的、那人宣称的「魔法咒语」，有好几句都是我中学的时候写的……我猜，其他「咒语」应该也都是中二病患者们在网上随口编的吧。真不知道那些句子都是从哪儿搜罗来的，不会是呗果吧？我明明已经把中学前的呗果记录都设成仅自己可见了啊……难道「黑之书」的「黑」其实是「黑客」的「黑」，还能抓取历史网页快照吗？
咳咳，扯远了。后来我听说，那个用黑之书骗人的人，自己也只是因为太想成为「特别的人」，才被黑之书蛊惑……如果真是这样，他其实也有点可怜。当、当然，我不是在替他说话啊！再怎么中二，骗人也是不对的！万一真的有人信了他的话，以为自己掌握了魔法，用所谓的「魔法」伤了自己可怎么办啊。我只是……稍微有一点点能理解他的那种心情罢了。希望自己是特别的，希望不会碌碌无为地过完一生。
不过话说回来了，我们每个人，不是本来就都是特别的吗？就算没有异能，没有魔法，没有任何特殊的力量，这个世界上也一定不会再有第二个哈尼娅！如果真有一模一样的另一个我——你不觉得，这本身就像一个传奇故事的开头吗？「平凡的少女哈尼娅，有一天突然遇到了一个和自己外貌、声音、性格、爱好……全都一模一样的女孩。是失散多年的双胞胎姐妹？还是某个神秘势力偷偷制造的克隆人？又或者，『哈尼娅』其实是某款量产机器人的代号，而对此一无所知的她，一直坚信自己是人类……」越想越有意思了！嗯嗯，今晚睡前的脑内小剧场就这么编！

More than the Black Tome itself, I think the people who exploit this kind of anomalies are far worse! I've been through many cases like this. Someone claimed that "if you follow the Black Tome's teachings, you can master magic" and "magic is a power that belongs to everyone and is greater than Esper Abilities." They used that whole spiel to trick so many people!
…Hm? How did I figure out he was a scammer? Ahaha… this is a bit embarrassing… Do I really have to tell you?
Well… several "magical incantations" printed in the Black Tome, the ones that guy claimed were real spells, were random words I wrote back in middle school… I'm guessing the other "incantations" were probably just made up by fellow online emo kids. I have no idea where they dug up all those phrases. It wasn't from Bagel, was it? I already set all my Bagel posts from before high school to private… Wait, is the "Black" in "Black Tome" actually short for "Black Hat Hacker"? Can it pull up archived web pages or something?
Urgh, I'm getting off track. Anyway, I heard later that the guy who used the Black Tome to trick people was just someone who desperately wanted to feel special, and that's how the Black Tome got to him… If that's true, he's kind of pitiful in a way. B-but of course, I'm not defending him or anything! No matter how special you want to be, it's still wrong to trick people! What if someone actually believed him and thought they'd learn real magic, then hurt themselves trying to cast those so-called "spells"? I just… somewhat get how he feels, that's it… wanting to be special. Hoping you won't just live an unremarkable life.
But thinking about it, aren't we all already special in our own way? Even without Esper Abilities, magic, or any extraordinary powers, there will never be another Haniel in this world! And if there really were another me who was exactly the same… don't you think that itself sounds like the beginning of an epic story? "The ordinary girl Haniel one day encounters a girl with the same looks, voice, personality, hobbies… Is she a twin sister separated at birth? Or a clone created by some mysterious organization? Or perhaps 'Haniel' is actually the model name of a mass-produced robot, and she, unaware of this fact, has always believed herself to be human…?" The more I think about it, the more interesting it gets! Yep, that's what I'll daydream about before bed tonight!

对该异象的危险程度评级为Ⅱ级。凭依种为原核体的一个分支。相较于其他原核体，凭依种没有稳定的形体，身体本身有类似雾气的物质组成。凭依种有一种近乎生物习性的行为模式，即附着在某件物体之上，从而隐藏起自己的本体。具报告分析，凭依种具有的行为模式有在刻意模仿智能生物的现象，这一点已经基本上可以确认。
介于凭依种自身的特质，一次追捕行动就想要摸清楚它的全部行为模式显然是困难的。现在无法得知，光线对于凭依种是否存在实质性的伤害，难以判断凭依种对背光环境的需求是否是其行动逻辑的必要条件。
用生活中的例子来说：夜间的飞蛾经常主动往路灯上撞击。通过这个行为推断飞蛾是趋光性的动物，喜欢光源。然而事实上导致这个行为的原因是飞蛾需要自然光源来引导飞行，人造光源的出现干扰了它们对于周围环境的感知，故而间接导致了撞向路灯。这是两种完全不同的原因引导的同一现象。
因此在面对该异象时，只持有光源而没有实质性的攻击手段是危险的行为。

This Anomaly is listed with a danger rating of Class II. Leech Spawns are a branch of Protocore Anomalies. Compared to other Protocore types, Leech Spawns are composed of a mist-like substance and have no stable, tangible form. Leech Spawns exhibit a behavioral pattern similar to that of a biological instinct: the desire to attach themselves to other objects to shroud their true form. According to reports, Leech Spawns often show a tendency to deliberately mimic intelligent life.
Given the nature of Leech Spawn, it's difficult to determine all of their behaviors from a single encounter. At present, it's impossible to know whether light causes any substantive harm, or whether their need for dark environments is a necessary condition for their actions.
For example, moths often fly into streetlamps at night. From this behavior, one could infer that moths are drawn to such light sources. However, the true reason moths are drawn to light is that their need to utilize natural light as guide markers for their flight. Artificial light interferes with this biological need, indirectly causing them to crash into streetlights. This is just one of the many examples of a similar phenomenon being driven by two entirely different causes.
Therefore, it's not recommended under any condition to approach this Anomaly with only a singular light source.

"「演艺周刊专访摘录：在终幕与虚无之间」
受访者：卡尔斯，知名电影导演「原市立剧院艺术总监」

A： ……新片的拍摄进展很顺利，女主角的镜头感很标准。但若是苛求最高艺术境界的话，说实话，自从古典舞台没落，我转行来拍电影之后，就越来越觉得如今这些镜头前的宠儿太爱惜自己的身体了，很难再呈现出当年剧院时代那种把命融进表演的极致质感。
Q：是否是指艾丽西娅·索隆的事？
A：没想到还有人记得她，那是一个才华横溢的芭蕾天才。她的天赋和刻苦简直称得上前无古人，可惜肉体太脆弱，早早透支到了极限。当名医正式下达了禁演令，认为她再也无法承受任何落地的冲击时，整个业界都在为这只早衰的天鹅叹息。
但幸运的是，她拥有一个对完美有着绝对信仰的编导，而她本人也有着同样超越常人的坚毅。现代的年轻人喜欢用世俗的道德观去批判什么强迫或者控制，但我认为在他们之间，根本不存在那些低俗的拉扯。
我看过那位编导留下的排练手记。现在的编导排练，都习惯用音响放一段录音。但他极其厌恶那些毫无人味的「死板杂音」。每当剧团乐师下班之后，编导都会亲自拿起那把不离身的小提琴，在练功房里为她做一对一的伴奏。只要琴声依旧，她的排练就绝不停。
为了纠正她足尖在空中0.2秒的迟滞，他可以在她关节严重积水的情况下，面不改色地用那把琴演奏，驱使她完成上百次极限跳跃。
而艾丽西娅也从来没有对指导的训练安排说过一个「不」字。如果肌肉因为剧痛而极度痉挛，就用硬质绑带强行把角度固死。如果舞鞋被渗出的血浸软导致了摩擦力改变，就立刻换上一双崭新的干鞋重来。她就像一台没有痛觉的精密仪器，踏着琴声继续起舞。
外人总爱用平庸的功利心去揣度她，甚至觉得她是受了胁迫。但只有真正懂艺术的人才明白，那是一个同样渴望极致的灵魂，在极度默契地配合导师的雕琢。那是两个为了完美演出而生，也愿意为完美而献身的共谋者。
所以，当冰冷的病床试图剥夺她谢幕的权利时，那位编导做出了最了不起的决定。他拿上那把不离身的小提琴，以及他们准备用在「终幕演出」里的女式道具指环，带着她离开了所有人的视线。前往林中完成那最后一场没有观众的演出，用这种方式，把艾丽西娅最完美的姿态永远定格在了巅峰……
Q：真是一段让人敬佩的故事。那么话说回来，导演您在这部致敬演艺圈的新片高潮中，会有什么独特的镜头表现吗？
A： 哈哈，你瞧我这记性，一聊起真正的大师就容易扯远。我们回归正题吧。关于这次新片高潮舞会戏份的运镜调度和美术布景，我们特别引入了……"

"Excerpt from a Performing Arts Weekly Interview: Between the Final Act and the Void"
Interviewee: Karls, renowned film director, and "Former Artistic Director of the Municipal Theater"

A:…The new film is coming along swell. The lead actress has a solid camera presence. However, if we're truly discussing the artistic standard, then, frankly… Well, ever since the decline of classical stages and the pivot into cinema, I've only grown more convinced that today's actresses are far too protective of their images. It's been a difficult transition for everyone. Bringing that unique theater-style intensity in front of the camera isn't really…
Q: Are you referring to Alicia Solon?
A: I'm surprised anyone still remembers her. She was a ballet prodigy, gifted to the point of genius. Her talent and discipline were unmatched, but her body was far too fragile. She burned through her potential early in her career, sadly. When she was declared banned from performing, she could no longer handle the situation and disappeared from the public sphere entirely.
Fortunately, she had a choreographer with resolute faith in her ability, to which she eventually responded in kind. Y'know, young people love to take a story and just run with it, throwing around words like "coercion" or "consent", but in my view, nothing of the sort existed between them.
I read through the notebook that the choreographer left behind. Nowadays, people just queue a recording over speakers for rehearsal. He despised that method entirely. Once the company musicians were off the clock, he'd pick up that little violin of his, that never left his side, mind you, and would personally accompany her, one-on-one, to the practice room. Her rehearsal didn't stop until the music did.
He would play continuously just to fix a mere half-second mistake in her dance, even if her joints were completely swollen.
Alicia, during these times, never once uttered a single "no" to his methods. If the pain made her muscles seize up, rigid straps were used to lock the angle in by force. If blood soaked her shoes, she'd immediately swap them for a fresh pair and begin anew.
Outsiders were desperate to judge her with their black-and-white worldview, even going so far as to assume she was being coerced. But those who truly have a passion for their crafts saw the truth: two souls starving for perfection, desperate to give their all.
So, when that cold, hard hospital bed tried to strip her of her spotlight, that choreographer made a choice. He took his violin, along with her, and led them both out of the public's eye. He went to the woods, desiring to finish that final performance with no audience—and thus, froze Alicia forever at her zenith…
Q: What an inspirational story. So then, Director, what kind of camera work can we, the audience, expect in your upcoming new film?
A: Haha, look at me—once I start talking, I can't ever stop. Let's get back on track. As for the camera movement, staging, and art design in this movie's ballroom climax, we've specially brought in…

关于游客口中的那个「巨人房间」的异象空间是一个值得调查的对象。目前为止，我们对于异象空间的认识是这样的：那是一个由异象单独生成的空间，在现实空间中具有幺正性。这既是说，哪怕异象空间在不同于现实的其他位面，同样能够通过一些手段，比如检测维特海默值来在我们的现实世界中进行定位。或许，我们可以借助数学上的概念帮助我们理解异象空间与现实世界的关系，它相当于是一个附着在现实世界的几何流形。
但是问题在于，镜中的那个世界并不像其他异象空间一样，是属于某个位面的空间。它仅仅存在于接触到异象后的人们的梦中。当然，我们对于梦境不比异象了解得更多。如果我们把梦境也看做某个位面的话，倒是能够解决这个令人困惑的问题。
如果梦境是链接另一个位面，或者说另一个世界的入口。使得我们能够不以肉身的形式穿越到那个奇异的空间当中。那么，我们当下的一切就足以值得怀疑：我们难道没有可能现在就在梦中吗？
就像是古代诗人们所流传的那样：「我们是与梦以相同的质料做成的。我们渺小的一生，睡一大觉便圆满了。」
Content.LocalizedString:
The Anomalous Realm behind the visitors' so-called "Giant Room" is a subject worth investigating. So far, our understanding of Anomalous Realms is as follows: they are spaces generated independently by an Anomaly, but can be accessed from elsewhere. In other words, even if an Anomalous Realm exists on a plane other than reality, it can still be located from our reality by certain means, such as detecting its Wertheimer Index. Perhaps mathematics can help us understand the relationship between Anomalous Realms and reality itself: Anomalous Realms are, in effect, a geometric manifold attached to the real world.
The problem, however, is that the world in the mirror does not seem to be a space belonging to any plane, unlike other Anomalous Realms. It exists only in the dream of those who have come into contact with the Anomaly. Of course, we understand dreams no better than we understand Anomalies. If we were to regard dreams as a plane in its own right, this puzzling problem could at least be resolved.
If dreams are a link to another plane—or rather, an entrance to another world—allowing us to cross into that strange space without our physical bodies, then everything becomes subject to doubt: How do we know if we're in a dream at all?
As the poets of eld have said: "We are such stuff as dreams are made on, and our little life is rounded with a sleep."
